title: PNC资管看财报季：市场不受青睐，标普500盈利能否重燃行情？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Amanda, Gaudi joins us now Chief Investment Officer at PNC Asset Management.
segments.zh: Amanda，Gaudi 现在加入我们，他是 PNC 资管的首席**官。

segments.en: Thank you very much for being here once again. I guess I could ask you about all of those AI stories in the newscast, which I found to be kind of alarming and might be...
segments.zh: 非常感谢你再次到来。我本想问问新闻里那些 AI 故事，我觉得有点令人担忧，可能……

segments.en: You just called me a doomer and then Lisa comes on telling us that the AI is basically swanning and filing babies' applications.
segments.zh: 你刚说我是悲观者，然后 Lisa 上来告诉我们 AI 基本上在到处游荡，还帮婴儿提交申请。

segments.en: Anyway, putting that all that aside. Hi Amanda. Nice to see you. Here we are on the press business of earning season.
segments.zh: 总之，先放一边。嗨 Amanda，很高兴见到你。我们正处在财报季的关键阶段。

segments.en: And I know that in quarters past you have been quite bullish about so what we've seen in earnings.
segments.zh: 我知道过去几个季度你对财报表现相当乐观。

segments.en: When you look at what we can expect here in the weeks ahead, what stands out to you? What are you watching most closely?
segments.zh: 展望未来几周，什么最让你关注？你最密切留意什么？

segments.en: Well, it's great to be with you both. Thanks so much for having me this morning.
segments.zh: 很高兴和你们两位在一起。非常感谢今早邀请我。

segments.en: I'm excited for earning season and yes, I have been bullish the last few quarters on the underlying fundamental strength.
segments.zh: 我对财报季很期待，是的，过去几个季度我一直看好基本面的强劲。

segments.en: I continue to believe that is underappreciated in this market environment.
segments.zh: 我仍然认为，在当前市场环境中，这一点被低估了。

segments.en: It's an unloved market. It feels like I can't get no satisfaction.
segments.zh: 这是一个不受青睐的市场。感觉就像我得不到满足。

segments.en: You know that one? Amanda, I had to go there.
segments.zh: 你知道吗？阿曼达，我不得不去那里。

segments.en: I had to, but I think fun musical references aside.
segments.zh: 我不得不去，但抛开有趣的音乐引用不谈。

segments.en: The fundamentals for Q3 look great. I mean, we're seeing pretty significant breadth in terms of expectations.
segments.zh: 三季度的基本面看起来很棒。我的意思是，我们看到了相当显著的预期广度。

segments.en: It's not following price returns. Breath has actually narrowed a lot.
segments.zh: 它没有跟随价格回报。广度实际上已经大幅收窄。

segments.en: But I think we're going to see a really strong result come out of Q3 earning season for the S&P 500.
segments.zh: 但我认为，标普500在三季度财报季将会有非常强劲的结果。

segments.en: I do think it will be enough to get this market rally reengaged and get maybe the bears.
segments.zh: 我确实认为，这足以让市场反弹重新启动，或许还能让空头。
